properties.entry: SELECT product_code, product_name, product_price, CASE WHEN stock_quantity >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS product_status, stock_quantity, category_code FROM tbl_product WHERE is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY product_code

SELECT product_code, product_name, product_price, CASE WHEN stock_quantity >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS product_status, stock_quantity, category_code FROM tbl_product WHERE product_code = ? AND is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT product_code, product_name, product_price, CASE WHEN stock_quantity >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS product_status, stock_quantity, category_code FROM tbl_product WHERE category_code = ? AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY product_code

SELECT product_code, product_name, product_price, CASE WHEN stock_quantity >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS product_status, stock_quantity, category_code FROM tbl_product WHERE product_name LIKE ? AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY product_code
INSERT INTO tbl_product (product_name, product_price, stock_quantity, category_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE tbl_product SET product_name = ?, product_price = ?, stock_quantity = ?, category_code = ? WHERE product_code = ? AND is_deleted = 'N'

UPDATE tbl_product p SET p.is_deleted = 'Y', p.stock_quantity = 0 WHERE p.product_code = ? AND p.is_deleted = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_order_item oi JOIN tbl_order o ON o.order_code = oi.order_code WHERE oi.product_code = p.product_code AND o.order_status = 'PENDING' )
